purpose: Three integration tests for AC-17302-14 driving rcf define create ac and rcf define read through bin/rcf.js in a fixture project.
title: rcf define create ac keeps the criterion's scope field from --from-file, on the file-only form, the --description merge form and a same-id replay

testCases.description: rcf define create ac --parent <US> --from-file <json> writes the scope the file carries; rcf define read shows it on the criterion
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/create-ac-keeps-scope.test.js::AC-17302-14: rcf define create ac --parent <US> --from-file <json> keeps the scope the file carries on the written criterion

testCases.description: rcf define create ac --parent <US> --description <text> --from-file <json> writes the scope the file carries, the CLI description winning
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/create-ac-keeps-scope.test.js::AC-17302-14: rcf define create ac --parent <US> --description <text> --from-file <json> keeps the scope the file carries (CLI fields merged over the file)

testCases.description: a same-id replay of a criterion that carries scope, with identical content, prints unchanged, exits 0 and leaves the US file byte-identical
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/create-ac-keeps-scope.test.js::AC-17302-14: a same-id replay (rcf define create ac --id) of a criterion that carries scope, with identical content, is unchanged (exit 0) and does not rewrite the file
